pages.text: Converts a text to a number.$(br2)$(1)isInteger$() is true if the text is a whole number. Use FIX to turn the value into an INTEGER then. A text that is not a number raises INVALID_ARGUMENT.
$(li)$(1)text$() STRING: the text, e.g. "42" or "3.5"$(li)result $(1)value$() FLOAT: the number$(li)result $(1)isInteger$() BOOLEAN: true if the text is a whole number
$(1)CALL c0de/strings/VAL$(br)  PARAMETER text input ;$(br)  RESULT value number$(br)  RESULT isInteger whole$()
